status: Implemented starting balance; verified by gameplay regressions, tuning requires playtesting

nodes.name: Iron Stomach
nodes.effect: +8% maximum HP. A successful Shield Bash block grants a 5%-max-HP shield for 3 seconds, once per cast; shields refresh rather than stack.

nodes.name: Shield Hook
nodes.effect: Shield Bash pulls ordinary enemies up to 70 units toward you. Displacement-immune bosses instead take +25% Bash damage; it never disrupts a scripted boss movement.

nodes.name: Brace And Break
nodes.effect: After 0.5 seconds without moving, your next Shield Bash gains a 120-degree cone and +35% damage. Store the charge for 2 seconds after moving.

nodes.name: Reinforced Guard
nodes.effect: Shield Wall lasts 2 seconds longer and reduces incoming damage by 60% instead of its baseline 50%.

nodes.name: Deflecting Bite
nodes.effect: Shield Bash heals 2% maximum HP per projectile blocked, capped at 8% per cast. Blocking multiple pellets from one attack counts once; no healing from allied effects.

nodes.name: Counterquake
nodes.effect: Preventing damage with Shield Wall or blocking a hostile attack grants one Quake charge, at most once per second. Next Groundbreaker consumes up to three: +20% damage each.

nodes.name: Bulwark Echo
nodes.effect: The first damaging ability within 4 seconds after Shield Wall repeats its damage area after 0.35 seconds at 40% power. The echo has no movement, healing, or proc triggers.

nodes.name: Unmoving Mountain
nodes.effect: Once per run, a lethal hit leaves you at 25% HP and grants Shield Wall plus 1.5 seconds of invulnerability. While Wall is active, your first blocked attack empowers the next basic by 100%.

nodes.name: Serrated Opening
nodes.effect: Basic hits apply one Bleed dealing 0.12A per second for 4 seconds. Reapplication refreshes duration; it does not stack infinitely.

nodes.name: Red Sweep
nodes.effect: Whirlwind Dash applies the same 4-second Bleed independently of Serrated Opening. Its finishing slash deals +25% damage to an already bleeding target.

nodes.name: Deep Cuts
nodes.effect: Your Bleed lasts 6 seconds and deals 0.16A per second. Requires an equipped Bleed source; total tick damage and expiry are visible on the target.

nodes.name: Blood Price
nodes.effect: Groundbreaker can be cast with at most 2 seconds of cooldown remaining by paying 6% maximum HP. This cannot kill you or activate below 30% HP.

nodes.name: Hemorrhage Pulse
nodes.effect: Groundbreaker consumes up to 3 seconds of remaining Bleed and deals that damage immediately with a 50% bonus. A target without Bleed takes a 2-second starter Bleed instead.

nodes.name: Crimson Trail
nodes.effect: Whirlwind leaves a 3-second trail dealing 0.12A per second, doubled against bleeding targets. Overlapping trails from the same player do not stack.

nodes.name: Reaver Rhythm
nodes.effect: Alternating a basic hit and a damaging ability hit extends your Bleed by 1 second and grants the ability +15% damage. Extension is capped at 6 seconds remaining; duplicates do not count.

nodes.name: Bloodstorm
nodes.effect: Whirlwind applies Bleed when absent. Against bleeding targets, consume remaining Bleed for 150% of its pending damage, capped at 2A, then emit one 0.5A finishing burst per cast.

nodes.name: Wider Quake
nodes.effect: Groundbreaker radius increases by 25%. Its outer quarter deals +20% damage, rewarding deliberate spacing.

nodes.name: Stonefist
nodes.effect: After Groundbreaker, your next three basic hits within 5 seconds produce a 48-unit aftershock for 0.25A.

nodes.name: Fault Line
nodes.effect: Groundbreaker also creates a 220-unit forward fissure. Targets outside the central circle take 0.6A from the fissure; a target in both areas receives only the main hit.

nodes.name: Aftershock
nodes.effect: Groundbreaker repeats after 0.45 seconds at 45% damage. The repeat uses the original position, allowing setup against committed attacks; it cannot generate another repeat.

nodes.name: Shock Bash
nodes.effect: Shield Bash reach increases by 25% and damage by 30%. Hitting an ordinary enemy near maximum reach staggers it for 0.4 seconds; bosses receive damage without a forced stun.

nodes.name: Rubble Guard
nodes.effect: Groundbreaker creates a 1-second rubble boundary that blocks up to three hostile projectiles. The boundary matches its art; it does not block beams, contact, or allied shots.

nodes.name: Earth Battery
nodes.effect: Groundbreaker destroys hostile projectiles inside its impact area. Each distinct hostile attack cleared refunds 0.5 seconds of its cooldown, capped at 2 seconds per cast.

nodes.name: Worldsplitter
nodes.effect: Every third Groundbreaker emits three visible forward shockwaves. Each target can take up to two wave hits for 0.6A each. A persistent counter shows the next empowered cast.

nodes.name: Titan Stance
nodes.effect: Casting Groundbreaker within 120 units of a boss grants 15% damage reduction for 2 seconds and +20% damage to that cast. Remove the self-slow penalty.

nodes.name: Long Mark
nodes.effect: Marked Shot lasts 8 seconds and provides six empowered basic hits. A visible six-pip indicator replaces the ambiguous timer-only mark; last-hit interactions use these pips.

nodes.name: Clean Angle
nodes.effect: Marked basic hits gain +20 percentage points to their existing damage bonus. A shot fired after 0.3 seconds of steady aim gains another +15%; moving cancels only the steady-aim charge.

nodes.name: Piercing Mark
nodes.effect: Marked Shot pierces up to two ordinary enemies and marks each. On a single boss its first hit deals +35% damage, so this purchase remains useful in boss-only encounters.

nodes.name: Snap Aim
nodes.effect: Tumble loads a Precision arrow for 4 seconds. Your next basic hit deals +60% damage and the arrow pierces one enemy. The damage charge is consumed by that first hit.

nodes.name: Bullseye Refund
nodes.effect: Consuming the last Mark pip refunds 35% of Marked Shot's base cooldown. Trigger once per mark application, including against bosses; ordinary marked hits do not repeatedly refund it.

nodes.name: Marked Detonation
nodes.effect: The last Mark pip detonates for 0.8A in an 80-unit radius. Marked enemy death also detonates once, using the same application ID so last-hit kills cannot double-trigger.

nodes.name: Perfect Distance
nodes.effect: Hitting a marked target from 180 to 320 units grants +25% damage to that basic.

nodes.name: Execution Mark
nodes.effect: Marked Shot supplies its own six-pip mark. Marked basic hits gain up to +50% damage as target HP falls from 50% to zero; below 20%, the last pip deals an extra 1A.

nodes.name: Pocket Trap
nodes.effect: Tumble drops a 5-second trap at its starting point. It fires three 0.35A arrows at the triggering enemy; bosses can trigger it, and the trap shows its armed radius.

nodes.name: Wide Net
nodes.effect: Arrow Trap trigger radius increases by 40%. Its first arrow deals +30% damage, preserving a useful benefit against a lone boss without making every arrow stronger.

nodes.name: Barbed Springs
nodes.effect: Trap hits slow ordinary enemies by 35% for 2 seconds. Displacement-immune bosses instead take a 2-second Wounded effect: +15% damage from your basic attacks.

nodes.name: Trap Chain
nodes.effect: Arrow Trap gains a second charge. Recharge is sequential and unchanged; only two placed traps from this ability can be active per player.

nodes.name: Barbed Volley
nodes.effect: Trap arrows deal +30% damage. Every third arrow fired by one trap pierces once; a boss struck by it instead receives a +25% third-arrow bonus.

nodes.name: Tripwire Volley
nodes.effect: When a trap triggers, it prioritizes your marked target if one is in its 320-unit firing range. Its first shot also adds one Mark pip, capped at six.

nodes.name: Snare Field
nodes.effect: Two traps within 220 units form a visible tripwire. A crossing enemy triggers one 0.8A volley and a 1-second ordinary-enemy root; each pair triggers once, bosses take damage without rooting.

nodes.name: Hunting Grounds
nodes.effect: Traps reload after 1.5 seconds and may trigger three times before expiring. Each trigger fires three 0.4A arrows. Maximum two traps, with distinct per-trigger hit IDs and clear remaining-charge pips.

nodes.name: Broad Storm
nodes.effect: Arrow Storm radius increases by 25%. Its first pulse slows ordinary enemies by 25% for 1 second; bosses take an additional 0.2A first-pulse hit instead.

nodes.name: Rapid Rain
nodes.effect: Arrow Storm pulses 25% faster with the same per-pulse damage.

nodes.name: Storm Follows
nodes.effect: Holding the Storm key while its field is active steers it toward the cursor at up to 90 units per second. Release leaves it stationary; steering cannot move it through room boundaries.

nodes.name: Lingering Clouds
nodes.effect: Arrow Storm lasts 1.2 seconds longer. This adds actual scheduled pulses; the displayed pulse count updates when equipped.

nodes.name: Rain Marking
nodes.effect: The first Storm pulse applies a 4-second, two-pip weak Mark. Later pulses cannot refresh it. Existing stronger marks retain their duration and gain at most one pip.

nodes.name: Cyclone Step
nodes.effect: Tumbling from inside your Storm emits a 90-unit ring pulse for 0.6A. Once per Storm cast; bonus attacks cannot produce another pulse.

nodes.name: Cloudburst
nodes.effect: Casting Marked Shot or Arrow Trap while inside your Storm produces one extra 0.35A pulse. Limit one pulse per ability cast and two per Storm.

nodes.name: Skyfall Engine
nodes.effect: Storm ends with a clearly marked 0.8A Skyfall strike. Direct basic hits on a target inside it add 0.2A to that strike, up to five charges.

nodes.name: Endless Quiver
nodes.effect: Every third basic hit on a target inside your Storm calls one falling arrow for 0.4A.

nodes.name: Scorching Blast
nodes.effect: Fire Blast applies a Burn dealing 0.15A per second for 4 seconds. Burns refresh rather than stack; a visible duration and tick preview confirms the effect.

nodes.name: Hotter Blast
nodes.effect: Fire Blast explosion radius increases by 25%. Direct projectile impact deals an extra 0.3A, rewarding accurate aim even against a single target.

nodes.name: Kindling Rune
nodes.effect: Blink leaves a 3-second fire rune at its starting point. First contact applies a 4-second Burn and deals 0.4A; a target triggers the rune only once.

nodes.name: Combustion
nodes.effect: Fire Blast deals +25% direct damage. Against a burning target, it also consumes up to 2 seconds of pending Burn for immediate damage without an extra multiplier.

nodes.name: Molten Splash
nodes.effect: A Meteor hitting a burning target creates a 2-second lava patch for 0.1A per second. Limit one patch per second and one active damage patch per target per player.

nodes.name: Chain Ignite
nodes.effect: A burning enemy's death spreads its remaining Burn to two enemies within 150 units. With no recipient, the death instead refunds 1 second of Fire Blast cooldown, at most once per second.

nodes.name: Flame Debt
nodes.effect: Fire Blast may be cast with at most 2 seconds remaining by paying 5% maximum HP. Disabled below 30% HP, cannot kill, and displays the health cost before accepting the cast.

nodes.name: Inferno Core
nodes.effect: Fire Blast applies Burn itself. Every third cast creates an Inferno explosion for +75% direct damage and a 3-second 0.2A-per-second fire field.

nodes.name: Wide Field
nodes.effect: Meteor Field radius increases by 25%.

nodes.name: Falling Stars
nodes.effect: Meteors arrive 25% faster. The total scheduled impact count stays fixed; this compresses the burst window rather than silently adding unlimited damage.

nodes.name: Molten Sky
nodes.effect: Meteor Field schedules two additional impacts over 1.2 extra seconds. The preview shows both the new total and duration, including when combined with Falling Stars.

nodes.name: Gravity Well
nodes.effect: The field pulls ordinary enemies toward its center at 45 units per second. Immovable bosses hit in the inner half instead take +15% Meteor damage.

nodes.name: Impact Echo
nodes.effect: Every third scheduled meteor repeats its impact after 0.35 seconds at 40% damage. Repeats do not advance meteor counters or spawn another echo.

nodes.name: Star Brand
nodes.effect: Meteor hits apply one Star Brand for 5 seconds. Fire Blast consumes it for an extra 0.8A; maximum one brand per target and one detonation per Blast.

nodes.name: Meteor Armor
nodes.effect: While inside your Meteor Field, take 20% less damage. The protection persists for 0.75 seconds after leaving so dodging is not immediately punished.

nodes.name: Cataclysm
nodes.effect: Meteor Field finishes with one visibly targeted meteor for 1.5A. Each distinct target hit during the field adds 0.15A, capped at 0.6A; single bosses retain the full base payoff.

nodes.name: Orbiting Star
nodes.effect: After casting Fire Blast, store one orbiting star for 5 seconds. Your next direct basic hit releases it for 0.5A. Only one star can be stored; it does not trigger Brand or echoes.

nodes.name: Wide Warp
nodes.effect: Time Warp radius increases by 25%. Entering it grants a 1-second, 5%-max-HP shield, once per Warp cast; the larger field is useful for self and teammates.

nodes.name: Long Warp
nodes.effect: Time Warp lasts 1.5 seconds longer.

nodes.name: Echo Blink
nodes.effect: Blink gains 20% range and leaves a 2-second return marker. Press Blink again during that window to return once without a second cooldown reset or new marker.

nodes.name: Frozen Second
nodes.effect: Three direct hits within your Warp freeze an ordinary enemy for 0.6 seconds. Bosses instead receive a delayed 0.6A rupture; once per target per Warp, with visible hit pips.

nodes.name: Borrowed Time
nodes.effect: Casting Fire Blast or Meteor Field inside Warp refunds 0.8 seconds of the other offensive ability. At most 2.4 seconds per cooldown per Warp; cannot refund itself.

nodes.name: Delayed Blast
nodes.effect: Fire Blast exploding inside Warp leaves a visible timer and repeats at 40% direct damage after 0.8 seconds. The repeat cannot Burn, consume Brand, or generate another echo.

nodes.name: Rewind Ward
nodes.effect: Entering your Warp grants a 10%-max-HP ward for 3 seconds. Unused ward refunds 1 second of Blink cooldown when it expires, once per Warp.

nodes.name: Time Loop
nodes.effect: Once per run, lethal damage returns you to your position 2 seconds earlier with 30% HP and 1 second of invulnerability. Each Warp also stores your first basic to repeat once at 50% damage.

nodes.name: Toxic Edge
nodes.effect: Maximum Poison stacks increase from five to seven.

nodes.name: Vile Dose
nodes.effect: Poison tick damage increases by 25%. Use the same declared attack-damage scaling on enemies and bosses; remove any unrelated flat tick value that becomes negligible later.

nodes.name: Spreading Cloud
nodes.effect: Poison Cloud radius increases by 25% and duration by 1 second. Cloud ticks add at most one stack per target per second.

nodes.name: Volatile Toxin
nodes.effect: A poisoned enemy's death releases a 0.6A toxin burst and two Poison stacks within 90 units. A poisoned boss crossing each 25%-HP threshold releases the same burst once.

nodes.name: Contaminated Smoke
nodes.effect: Smoke applies one Poison stack per second to enemies inside it. A target must be inside the actual field; Smoke from an echo does not create a second stacking source.

nodes.name: Toxin Bloom
nodes.effect: Reaching maximum Poison stacks spreads two stacks to two nearby targets. With no neighbor, deal 0.5A to the original target instead. Per-target 3-second cooldown; refreshed max stacks do not spam it.

nodes.name: Venom Bank
nodes.effect: Applying three direct Poison stacks stores one Venom charge, up to three. Backstab consumes them for +20% damage each.

nodes.name: Venom Nova
nodes.effect: At maximum stacks, the next Backstab detonates pending Poison for up to 1.5A and leaves two stacks. Applies its own three Poison stacks on an unpoisoned target, so the engine works independently.

nodes.name: Plague Artist
nodes.effect: Poison Cloud follows the last directly poisoned boss at 70 units per second, with a fixed 4-second duration. It never teleports or follows across a phase transition.

nodes.name: Dirty Knife
nodes.effect: Backstab deals +25% damage. Hitting from the rear grants one Exposed stack and a clearly labeled rear-hit flash; rear direction is defined by the target's committed facing.

nodes.name: Deep Expose
nodes.effect: Exposed lasts 2 seconds longer. Your first basic after Backstab deals +30% damage against an Exposed target; the ready indicator expires after 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Long Shadow
nodes.effect: Shadowstep grants 20% more travel distance and empowers the next Backstab within 3 seconds for +30% damage. It does not redirect unexpectedly to a hidden target.

nodes.name: Ambush Echo
nodes.effect: Shadowstep leaves a delayed 70-unit burst at its endpoint after 0.25 seconds for 0.6A. The burst cannot trigger another echo or refund.

nodes.name: Expose Bleed
nodes.effect: Backstab against an Exposed target applies a 4-second wound dealing 0.15A per second. This is one refreshing wound, not a new unlimited damage stack.

nodes.name: Death Mark
nodes.effect: An Exposed target with at least three Poison stacks takes +20% Backstab damage. Backstab itself applies one Poison stack when equipped, providing a usable setup without a separate Poison talent.

nodes.name: Knife Dance
nodes.effect: A Backstab kill refunds 50% of Shadowstep's cooldown. A rear Backstab on a boss refunds 20% instead, once per Backstab cast; both outcomes cannot trigger from one hit.

nodes.name: Deathblow
nodes.effect: Backstab applies one Exposed stack if none is present. Otherwise consume up to three stacks for +30% damage each; a rear hit refunds 30% of Backstab's cooldown once per cast.

nodes.name: Heavy Smoke
nodes.effect: Smoke radius increases by 25%. On entering your Smoke, your next basic within 2 seconds gains +25% damage, once per field cast.

nodes.name: Lingering Cover
nodes.effect: Smoke lasts 1.5 seconds longer. Its protection persists for 0.5 seconds after leaving, allowing an intentional escape without a sharp protection cliff.

nodes.name: Black Powder
nodes.effect: Black Powder clears ordinary hostile projectiles inside Smoke when cast. Each distinct attack cleared gives 0.5 seconds of Shadowstep cooldown recovery, capped at 2 seconds; beams remain visible and unaffected.

nodes.name: Smoke Step
nodes.effect: Shadowstep from inside Smoke grants 0.75 seconds of untargetability against newly aimed ordinary attacks. Existing hazards still damage you; a visible silhouette and icon communicate the exact state.

nodes.name: Noxious Cover
nodes.effect: Directly poisoning an enemy inside your Smoke deals a bonus 0.2A, at most once per target per second. Poison ticks and field-generated stacks cannot trigger this bonus.

nodes.name: Blind Spot
nodes.effect: Backstab against a target inside your Smoke receives its rear-hit bonus from any angle. The target, not just the player, must be within the visible field.

nodes.name: Vanishing Act
nodes.effect: A single hit costing at least 20% maximum HP drops a 2-second mini Smoke at your position. Twenty-second cooldown.

nodes.name: Blackout
nodes.effect: Smoke lasts 1 second longer and slows ordinary hostile projectiles inside it by 60% instead of 50%. Your first three basics fired from that field gain +35% damage; beams and ground hazards are unaffected.

nodes.name: Wider Light
nodes.effect: Consecration radius increases by 25%. Its first pulse grants allies a 5%-max-HP shield for 2 seconds; the shield uses the recipient's HP and refreshes instead of stacking.

nodes.name: Lasting Prayer
nodes.effect: Consecration lasts 1.5 seconds longer. Scheduled damage and support pulses are displayed, including the added pulses, rather than extending only the visual effect.

nodes.name: Holy Burn
nodes.effect: Consecration deals +25% pulse damage and applies a 2-second Holy Burn totaling 0.2A. Holy Burns refresh; multiple Paladins do not multiply the same owner's stacks.

nodes.name: Sacred Footing
nodes.effect: Inside Consecration, slow strength and knockback distance are reduced by 60%. Protection persists 0.75 seconds after leaving; this does not suppress mandatory boss arena movement.

nodes.name: Radiant Edge
nodes.effect: Basic hits while inside Consecration emit a short holy cleave for 0.25A, once per basic. A target can receive the main hit and one cleave; the cleave does not chain procs.

nodes.name: Divine Domain
nodes.effect: Divine Domain grants 15% faster ability cooldown recovery inside your Consecration. Multiple fields use the strongest bonus, capped with other recovery bonuses.

nodes.name: Hallowed Echo
nodes.effect: Radiant Smite cast inside Consecration repeats at 40% damage after 0.35 seconds. The repeat cannot repeat again, heal, reapply Judgment, or advance third-cast counters.

nodes.name: Cathedral Field
nodes.effect: Consecration grows by 30% over its first 2 seconds. Leaving grants an 8%-max-HP shield for 3 seconds once per ally per cast; field expiry emits a single 1A holy burst.

nodes.name: Sunlit March
nodes.effect: Aegis Dash leaves a 3-second holy strip dealing 0.12A per second and granting allies 10% movement speed. Overlapping strips from one player do not stack.

nodes.name: Mercy Ward
nodes.effect: Bulwark activation heals you and nearby allies for 6% of each recipient's maximum HP. Once per cast; healing echoes and overheal do not recursively trigger support talents.

nodes.name: Blessed Plate
nodes.effect: Bulwark reduces incoming damage by 60% instead of 50%. Prevented damage is recorded visibly for Vow Of Return, but immunity does not generate prevented-damage credit.

nodes.name: Projectile Ward
nodes.effect: Aegis Dash clears ordinary projectiles within its visible shield path. Clearing at least one distinct hostile attack grants an 8%-max-HP shield for 3 seconds, once per dash.

nodes.name: Vow Of Return
nodes.effect: Damage prevented by Bulwark empowers your next Smite within 5 seconds: add 50% of prevented damage, capped at 1A. Taking unrelated damage does not generate this bonus.

nodes.name: Aegis Anchor
nodes.effect: Ending Aegis Dash within 140 units of a boss grants a 10%-max-HP shield for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Shared Bulwark
nodes.effect: Bulwark grants nearby allies a 10%-max-HP shield for 3 seconds. In solo, your shield becomes 15%; choose the strongest active shield rather than stacking several copies.

nodes.name: Martyr Spark
nodes.effect: The first hostile hit that breaks your shield emits a 0.8A holy pulse. Once per shield application, with a 2-second cooldown; shield expiry and allied damage cannot trigger it.

nodes.name: Unfallen
nodes.effect: Once per run, lethal damage restores 25% HP and grants Bulwark plus 1.5 seconds of invulnerability. Each Bulwark also grants allies a 5%-max-HP shield on activation.

nodes.name: Sharp Judgment
nodes.effect: Radiant Smite deals +25% direct damage. A clear impact flash and damage breakdown distinguish the improvement from Holy Burn and other secondary effects.

nodes.name: Wide Verdict
nodes.effect: Smite radius increases by 25%. A target at the exact center takes an extra 0.25A once, rewarding precision without multiplying every splash hit.

nodes.name: Marked Guilty
nodes.effect: Smite applies Judgment for 5 seconds: the target takes +15% damage from your direct attacks. Other players see the mark, but it does not stack into a party-wide exponential multiplier.

nodes.name: Chain Verdict
nodes.effect: Smite chains once to a nearby enemy for 60% damage. With no second enemy within 160 units, the main target instead takes +25% Smite damage; the chain cannot chain again.

nodes.name: Trial By Fire
nodes.effect: Smite consumes up to 2 seconds of Holy Burn for double its pending damage. Against an unburning target it applies a 2-second starter Holy Burn, making the interaction self-contained.

nodes.name: Judgment Day
nodes.effect: Every third direct Smite leaves a 3-second holy zone dealing 0.15A per second.

nodes.name: Final Appeal
nodes.effect: Smite on a judged target heals you for 5% maximum HP, at most once per cast. In co-op it also heals the lowest-health nearby ally for 3%; no heal from immune hits.

nodes.name: Final Judgment
nodes.effect: Smite applies Judgment if absent. Against an already judged target, consume it for +60% direct damage and reduce Smite cooldown by 20%, once per cast; no mark or refund from an echo.

nodes.name: Louder Chord
nodes.effect: Power Chord deals +25% direct damage. The impact displays its direct damage separately from song scaling so the purchased improvement is easy to confirm.

nodes.name: Harmonic Strike
nodes.effect: Power Chord gains an additional +10% base damage per distinct active song, capped at three. Multiple copies of one song count once.

nodes.name: Resonant Finale
nodes.effect: A direct Power Chord hit extends your active songs by 0.75 seconds, once per cast. Maximum 2.25 seconds added to each song application, avoiding permanent-song loops.

nodes.name: Bass Cleave
nodes.effect: Power Chord becomes a 120-degree wave with 20% more reach. A target receives one hit per cast; the broader shape is shared by the visual and collision paths.

nodes.name: Dissonance
nodes.effect: Power Chord reduces a target's outgoing ordinary attack damage by 15% for 3 seconds. Multiple Bards refresh the strongest debuff; scripted percentage-HP mechanics are not altered.

nodes.name: Echo Note
nodes.effect: Every second direct Power Chord repeats after 0.3 seconds at 40% damage. The echo cannot extend songs, advance the counter, heal, or create another echo.

nodes.name: Shatter Chord
nodes.effect: Power Chord gains +15% damage per distinct Mark, Poison, Burn, Bleed, or Judgment status on the target, capped at +45%. Repeated stacks of one status count once.

nodes.name: Grand Finale
nodes.effect: With three distinct songs active, Power Chord deals +60% damage and produces a 0.5A finishing pulse. Each direct cast can produce one pulse.

nodes.name: Encore Blast
nodes.effect: A direct Chord kill creates one 50%-damage Chord toward the nearest hostile target. On a lone boss, every third direct Chord creates it instead; one extra Chord per cast, no recursion.

nodes.name: Brave Tempo
nodes.effect: Battle Hymn's damage bonus increases by 10 percentage points. Use the strongest matching aura, never multiply several Bards' copies.

nodes.name: Fast Rhythm
nodes.effect: Battle Hymn grants an additional 15% attack speed. Combined attack-speed bonuses are capped at +50%; the character sheet displays the actual basic attack interval.

nodes.name: Wide Chorus
nodes.effect: Battle Hymn and Quickstep radius increase by 30%. Leaving either retains its benefit for 1 second, once refreshed on re-entry.

nodes.name: Marching Beat
nodes.effect: Battle Hymn grants 12% movement speed to its recipients. Use the strongest matching aura and cap combined movement bonuses at +25%; the Bard receives the benefit in solo.

nodes.name: War Anthem
nodes.effect: A Power Chord cast from inside your Hymn gains +25% direct damage. The cast-origin position decides eligibility, and the ready icon appears before releasing it.

nodes.name: Haste Verse
nodes.effect: Battle Hymn grants recipients 15% faster ability cooldown recovery while inside. Use the strongest aura; combined recovery is capped at +30%.

nodes.name: Rallying Echo
nodes.effect: A recipient casting a damaging ability inside your Hymn emits one 0.2A pulse around the caster. Shared 0.75-second pulse cooldown per Bard; solo casts qualify and bonus attacks do not.

nodes.name: Anthem Of Chaos
nodes.effect: Battle Hymn lasts 2 seconds longer. After three direct basic hits while benefiting from it, release one 0.5A chord pulse; the counter is yours, not multiplied by party size.

nodes.name: Warm Notes
nodes.effect: Healing Ballad heals 25% more. Any overheal creates a shield up to 5% of the recipient's maximum HP for 2 seconds; repeated ticks refresh, not stack, the shield.

nodes.name: Lingering Melody
nodes.effect: Healing Ballad lasts 1.5 seconds longer and schedules its corresponding extra healing pulses.

nodes.name: Shared Breath
nodes.effect: Healing Ballad recipients take 12% less ordinary damage while inside, retaining protection for 0.5 seconds after leaving. Use the strongest matching effect.

nodes.name: Cleansing Note
nodes.effect: Ballad activation clears one movement debuff from each recipient: pickle slow, chill, then grease, in that priority order. Required boss objective markers remain.

nodes.name: Gentle Reprise
nodes.effect: Leaving Ballad grants a heal of 4% maximum HP after 1 second, once per recipient per song application. Repeated boundary crossing cannot produce extra heals.

nodes.name: Rescue Verse
nodes.effect: Ballad's first pulse on a recipient below 35% HP heals an extra 8% maximum HP. Once per recipient per song application.

nodes.name: Sanctuary Song
nodes.effect: Ordinary hostile projectiles travel 30% slower inside Ballad. Their damage and lifetime remain unchanged; beams, contact attacks, and ground hazards are explicitly unaffected.

nodes.name: Encore Recovery
nodes.effect: Once per run, crossing below 25% HP automatically plays a 3-second emergency Ballad and grants a 10%-max-HP shield. Ordinary Ballad activations also grant a 3%-max-HP first-pulse shield.
